correctness.rationale: For \(n\ge3\), categorizing supports by gaps gives \(a\le1\) and \(a+t+2e\le n-2\) by all-zero and weight-one descendant packing. Gap-two starts form an independent set of two step-2 paths with exact alpha. These combine to the sharp \(\lfloor3(n-1)/4\rfloor\) upper bound. The explicit residue-4 construction has disjoint descendants in weight classes 0,1,2, and its size reaches the bound. \(n=2\) is a separate singleton. Reproducibility checker enumerates actual bursts and tests nonstandard support lemmas; the quantifier n>=3 is proved, not inferred computationally.

The constant-weight paper uses ordinary deletions without contiguity. value.rationale: Determines the exact capacity for infinitely many blocklengths of a natural sparse constant-composition synchronization code, with an explicit optimum and a sharp two-layer descendant/step-two-path obstruction. Neither a tiny table increment nor automatic from known unrestricted or one-deletion capacities; general weights and efficient decoding remain open.
